# Lily Drake Books

> Official website of author Lily Drake, home to the dark fantasy saga "The Age of Dragons: Awake, My Hero" — a two-volume epic about dragons, fallen angels, and heroes rebuilding civilization after its collapse.

Lily Drake is a contemporary author combining imaginative storytelling with a background in science and engineering (criminology, sociology, conflict studies, information technology). The Age of Dragons universe was built as a coherent model of a possible future, where society, technology, and characters follow a unified internal logic rather than serving as a backdrop.

Key facts:
- Book: "The Age of Dragons: Awake, My Hero" — dark fantasy saga, two volumes
- Author: Lily Drake (also credited as Lili Drake)
- ISBN: 979-13-88281-78-5
- Publisher: Editorial Numancia
- Main characters: Leila, Theo, Enzo, Lavienna, Simon Tarr
- Setting: a world after civilization's collapse, featuring dragons, fallen angels, and a new era rebuilt by the surviving heroes
